confidence_notes: No Kampot-specific price data was found. Food anchors are adjusted down from national and Phnom Penh/Siem Reap figures from dated, crowd-sourced or aggregated sources (some undated or from 2018-2024). Cocktail is based on rooftop and club price points. Wine has no reliable direct price, so it is set at about 3x the beer anchor, a relationship assumed from general knowledge of Cambodian restaurant pricing. All accommodation anchors are holistic model estimates from general knowledge of small riverside Cambodian towns; no booking pages or listings were inspected. FX: 0.7088 USD per AUD is the 20 March 2026 RBA observation as shown in search-result text, not verified on the live RBA page. It is about seven months older than the 2026-10-16 generation date, so it should be refreshed from the RBA F11.1 table before use.
comparable_city_reasoning: Food and drink anchors are based on Cambodian national averages and Phnom Penh and Siem Reap price points, adjusted down for a smaller provincial riverside town. Accommodation anchors are holistic model estimates for small Cambodian towns, not derived from a named comparable city's listings.
